name: Pixel Launch 👾
desc:
🐖 BE your MOB and race to the END!

How To Play
💵 BE a Minecraft Item to get RICH!
🏢 BUILD a tall skyscraper to launch FARTHER!
🐖 UPGRADE your mob to increase SPEED!
🌍 TRAVEL to new countries for rare TOWERS!
😀 VISIT your friends buildings and RACE them!

New Update:

👍 Make sure to LIKE and FAVORITE for more updates!
